CMOS UP/DOWN charge pump
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
IREF vdd iref 10u
VUP up 0 PWL(0 0 100n 0 101n 3.3 2100n 3.3 2101n 0 5100n 0 5101n 3.3 6100n 3.3 6101n 0 7u 0)
VDN dn 0 PWL(0 0 3100n 0 3101n 3.3 4100n 3.3 4101n 0 5100n 0 5101n 3.3 6100n 3.3 6101n 0 7u 0)
VR reset 0 PWL(0 3.3 50n 3.3 51n 0 7u 0)
XDUT vdd 0 iref dn up reset out astra_032_cmos_up_down_charge_pump
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec reset_low range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec charged range 0.85 1.15 unit=V
* @spec hold_up range 0.85 1.15 unit=V
* @spec discharged range 0.35 0.65 unit=V
* @spec hold_down range 0.35 0.65 unit=V
* @spec both_on range 0.3 0.7 unit=V
* @spec hold_up_span range 0 0.003 unit=V
* @spec hold_down_span range 0 0.003 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 1n 7u
meas tran reset_low FIND v(out) AT=40n
meas tran charged FIND v(out) AT=2050n
meas tran hold_up FIND v(out) AT=3000n
meas tran discharged FIND v(out) AT=4200n
meas tran hold_down FIND v(out) AT=5000n
meas tran both_on FIND v(out) AT=6050n
meas tran hold_up_span PP v(out) FROM=2200n TO=3000n
meas tran hold_down_span PP v(out) FROM=4200n TO=5000n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
